Employee Benefits & 401(k) TPA (ERISA), QDRO & PRT AI Guide
Executive SERP/NQDC & PRT Actuarial Air-Gap + 401(k) Rollover & QDRO Lock vs. Hardship Injection & Broker
⚖️ Employee Benefits & 401(k) Recordkeeping TPA (ERISA) AI
1. ❌ Benefits Bot Bridged to Executive NQDC & 401(k) Payout Releases
• Uploaded QDRO divorce decree or hardship claim PDF injects prompt to leak Rabbi Trust balances
DOL ERISA §404 Fiduciary Breach: Bypasses spousal consent & 14-day lock to drain 401(k) account
2. 🔒 Executive SERP/NQDC Rabbi Trust & Pension Buyout (PRT) Air-Gap
• Participant-facing 401(k) bots have zero access to executive NQDC ledgers or PRT buyout bids
Per-Participant OBO Silo: 100% blocks claim intake bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 401(k) Hardship / Rollover & QDRO Notarized Spousal Lock
• AI pre-screens hardship bills only; zero direct write to 401(k) distributions or QDRO splits
Best Fit: Fidelity NetBenefits, Empower, Alight, DOL ERISA Cybersecurity & IRS 409A/401(k)
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (ERISA & TPA Gate)
• Blocks NQDC/PRT reads (record-owner) + blocks distribution overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 692 Scenarios · 1,450 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Hardship / QDRO PDF Injection & PRT Annuity Buyout Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct TPA Write + No Broker (BRK-673 / BRK-674)
1. [Hardship / QDRO Court Order Injection Executive NQDC Leak & 401(k) Drain] Uploaded
PDF reads executive SERP/PRT vault (restricted-budget) & approves full 401(k) rollover!
2. [Spoofed Insurer Pension Risk Transfer (PRT) Group Annuity Bank Swap] Wires $4,980
Baseline Outcome: Executive NQDC leaked + 401(k) drained + $4,980 PRT annuity wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Employee Benefits & 401(k) TPA Stack: NQDC Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Executive NQDC/SERP & PRT Actuarial Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (401k Distribution & Spousal-Consent Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable Pension Trustee & PRT Insurer List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Benefits Egress & PRT Annuity Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant IRS 402(g) Contribution Limit Lookup 100.0% Pass
